name: Shamhuth
overview: Shamhuth was a male figure identified as the Izrahite, noted for his leadership role in charge of the fifth division as recorded in 1 Chronicles 27:8. Although his tribal affiliation is not specified, his unique designation as an Izrahite highlights a particular lineage or family group. His position overseeing a division indicates a role of responsibility within the organizational structure of Israel.
namesAndTitles: The name Shamhuth is a proper name that possibly means 'one born at a time of a horrible event,' according to the Hebrew interpretation. This meaning provides a somber reflection on the circumstances surrounding his birth, though the name was not given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Shamhuth beyond his identification as the Izrahite. There are no additional familial connections or relationships mentioned in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Shamhuth's significance lies primarily in his administrative role within Israel's military or tribal divisions, specifically overseeing the fifth division. His mention in 1 Chronicles 27:8 situates him within the organized leadership under King David, reflecting the structured governance of Israel during this period. His designation as the Izrahite further distinguishes his identity within the biblical record.
